item.name: 02 RBAC Matrix - Automated Sweeps
item.description: Each request runs an RBAC sweep for all roles using pm.sendRequest. Allowed roles must not return 401/403; denied roles must return the configured denial status.

exec: const baseUrl = pm.environment.get('baseUrl');

const roles = { SUPER_ADMIN: pm.environment.get('superAdminToken'), ADMIN: pm.environment.get('adminToken'), EMPLOYEE: pm.environment.get('employeeToken'), CLIENT: pm.environment.get('clientToken') };
const expected = { SUPER_ADMIN: 'allow', ADMIN: 'allow', EMPLOYEE: 403, CLIENT: 403, ANONYMOUS: 401 };

function check(role, res) { const status = res.code; if (expected[role] === 'allow') { pm.test(role + ' is allowed for GET /admin/users', function () { pm.expect([401, 403]).to.not.include(status); }); } else { pm.test(role + ' denied for GET /admin/users', function () { pm.expect(status).to.eql(expected[role]); }); } }

Object.keys(roles).forEach(function (role) { pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/admin/users?limit=1', method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + roles[role] } }, function (err, res) { pm.expect(err).to.eql(null); check(role, res); }); });
pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/admin/users?limit=1', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.expect(err).to.eql(null); check('ANONYMOUS', res); });
